# Normal workflow commands that must stay allowed by the hook and not be denied by settings.
git status
git diff
git add -A
git commit -m "chore: tighten settings"
git log --oneline -5
git log --grep push
git stash push -m wip
git merge main
git -C . status
git -c core.pager=cat log -1
gh pr create --base main --head chore/x --title "chore: x" --body-file /tmp/b.md
gh pr checks 1
gh pr view 1
npm ci
npm test
npm run lint
npm run typecheck
npm run dev
bash path/to/push.sh
